app.tagline: Tune-up for Windows. Every change can be undone.
banner.readOnly: PitCrew is not running as administrator, so you can look but not change anything. Close it and open it again, answering Yes on the Windows prompt.
banner.otherUser: Windows approved administrator rights with a different account than the one signed in. Changes for "your user", cleanup of your files and app removal are blocked, because they would hit that other account.
banner.testMode: Test mode: restore points are turned off. Use this only in Windows Sandbox or a virtual machine.
page.performance.title: Performance
page.performance.intro: Only settings with a real, documented effect. Pick what you want and click Apply; PitCrew creates a restore point first.
page.privacy.title: Privacy
page.privacy.intro: Limit what Windows collects and shows you. Each item links to Microsoft's documentation for that setting.
page.cleanup.title: Cleanup
page.cleanup.intro: See how much space each item takes, then pick what to delete. Deleting can't be undone.
page.apps.title: Built-in apps
page.apps.intro: Remove preinstalled apps you don't use. They are removed only for your user and can be reinstalled from here.
page.drivers.title: Drivers
page.drivers.intro: Driver updates published on Windows Update. PitCrew checks whether each one is really newer than what you have.
page.about.title: About PitCrew
page.about.intro: Open source, no ads, no telemetry of its own.

about.text:
PitCrew is a free, open-source tune-up tool for Windows 10 and 11. Every setting it changes is recorded first, so it can be put back exactly as it was. It only includes settings with a documented, real effect; docs/NOT-INCLUDED.md lists popular tweaks we left out and why.

Translations other than English and Portuguese were machine-generated. Native speakers are welcome to review them.
